SQL: products + orders · Web / mobile client Order API · Cache: catalog only · Outbox + email worker

GET /products (cached read); POST /orders (authenticated, idempotent reservation); GET /orders/:id
(ownership check). Return 201 for new order, 409 for stock conflict, 400 for invalid quantity; replay the
stored result for the same key.

products(id PK, stock CHECK(stock >= 0))
orders(id PK, request_key UNIQUE, product_id, qty)
outbox(event_id PK, order_id, event_type)

Use stateless API replicas, indexed product IDs, cache only stale-tolerant fields, bounded worker
queues and observability. In production scope keys by user, compare complete request fingerprints,
enforce authorization, and write an outbox row in the same transaction.

DB unavailable: fail safely rather than accept unverified stock. Email failure: retry through the queue
without duplicating the order. Lost HTTP response: retry with the original key.

Interview structure: requirements → estimates → API → data model → architecture → failure modes
→ tradeoffs.
